I’d love to see the intricate designs being painted on hands and feet, hear the laughter and stories shared, and soak in the vibrant energy of the celebration. While I can’t physically be there, I’d be cheering you and your sister on from afar, imagining the glowing henna patterns and the love that makes these moments so special. Congratulations to your sister on her big day—may it be as radiant as the mehendi itself! 💛✨
